\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

7-12. Use the equivariant rank theorem to give another proof of Theorem 7.5 by showing that every Lie group homomorphism $F : G \rightarrow H$ is equivariant with respect to suitable smooth $G$ -actions on $G$ and $H$ . \end{exercise}
